lines.text: 🚨 Highbeam Deer, Highbeam Deer, Cliffhanger, Rut King, Night Court is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Highbeam Deer, Highbeam Deer, Cliffhanger, Rut King, Night Court at the door, day 8.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Go for the eyes — When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus.
🛡️ Fiona, Imani, Jalen, Nikos and Zoe met them at the door — 4 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Fiona, Imani, Nikos, Zoe are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Highbeam Deer, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
📓 Codex: a lean scout arrived (scout).
Word reaches you, days late: Imani stands accused over what happened to Chester. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
📓 Codex: Heard about the case against Imani.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1100 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Someone is crying, quietly, in one of the bunks. Sanne goes to sit with them.
Fireside lesson: Imani passes around Shea. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Fiona is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 16/100)
Imani is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 15/100)
Zoe and Fiona lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Aisha rests a hand on the pantry door, satisfied. "No one's going hungry this week. Sitting with the fever cases instead — someone should."
🍽️ Priya looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
📓 Codex: Imani taught Fiona Food Preservation.
— DAY 9 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ HIGHBEAM DEER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It BELLOWS — wrong, too deep, like a foghorn heard through water. The sound sits in your teeth.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
The deer's head swings toward you. Another light in its eyes. You're all on the list now.
The light behind its eyes swells to a painful glare. The whine climbs past hearing. It is done aiming — now it is only waiting to loose.
The Highbeam Deer thrashes its antlers at you — getting close has a price.
Highbeam Deer's antlers hits you for 13.
💥 A ray of light lances FROM ITS EYES — and it's swinging toward you. MOVE.
The light touches the ground where you were standing. It has not found you yet.
The beam swings wide, scorching the earth where you were.

📺 +5 style — solid hit
The beam swings wide, scorching the earth where you were.
The beam carves a bright arc across the ground, swinging after its target. It does not blink. It does not hurry.

🔥 the beam SITS on you! (58)
The Highbeam Deer thrashes its antlers at you — getting close has a price.
Highbeam Deer's antlers hits you for 11.
You go down.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Esteban Fernandez is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Aisha blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Esteban Fernandez, 9 days. The mantle passes to Aisha Szymanski.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Aisha Szymanski, 58 — a fishing guide. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes.
Nothing to eat. The pantry of your pack is empty.

Fiona shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Fiona telling Zoe about Sari. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🩹 Imani is still hurting (15 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
💬 Jalen has been asking Fiona about Green Whisper — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
💧 Sari returns with water: +3 clean.
🩹 Hassan is still hurting (65 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
👥 Sanne heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," Fiona says. (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Priya telling Jalen about Sari. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — Imani telling Nikos about Sari. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Priya stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch this happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."
"Or we rally," Priya adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

Sari is tending the fire, coaxing it steady.
